name: fix-gold-sprites
about: Gold pickups by amount (mods/goldworth items/materials/gold.unit): drops at each of the 15 thresholds show the bronze, silver and gold coin and four piles of items/misc/base.png (bronze 1/5/10/15/20, silver 25/50/75/100/150, gold 200/250/300/350/400+); amounts just under a threshold take the tier below; picking one up still pays. Screenshot of the 5 x 3 grid.
